summary: This note covers the song "Don't Be Cruel" by American singer Bobby Brown. It is the title track of his second and most successful album. The song was written and produced by Kenneth "Babyface" Edmonds and Antonio "L.A." Reid, with additional writing credited to Daryl Simmons.
one_line: Bobby Brown's title track from his second, most successful album, written and produced by Babyface and L.A. Reid with Daryl Simmons.
key_facts: "Don't Be Cruel" is a song recorded by American singer Bobby Brown.
The song is taken from Bobby Brown's second and most successful album, as its title track.
"Don't Be Cruel" was written and produced by the songwriting and production duo Kenneth "Babyface" Edmonds and Antonio "L.A." Reid.
Daryl Simmons contributed additional writing to "Don't Be Cruel".
The note describes Bobby Brown's album as his second and most successful album.
